ws.title: Workspace
ws.generalSub: Its name and the address in links.
ws.name: Name
ws.slugHelp: Links to this workspace: /w/{slug}. Old links stop working when it changes.
ws.readOnly: Only the owner can change this.
ws.slotsHelp: How many runs this workspace may have at once. Change it in Billing.
ws.suspended: This workspace is suspended: nothing new starts until it is resumed.
ws.dangerSub: Deleting stops every run and removes the workspace, its repositories' copies, tickets and history. It is kept 7 days for undo, then purged.
ws.deleteBody: Type the address ({slug}) to confirm. Everyone loses access.
ws.membersSub: Everyone in the workspace sees its tickets and can create, answer, review and retry them. The owner also manages settings, integrations, {agent}, members and billing.
ws.removeBody: They lose access to this workspace. Their tickets stay.
ws.transferBody: You stay a member but can no longer change settings, members or billing.
ws.leaveBody: You lose access until someone invites you again.
ws.ownerCannotLeave: The owner cannot leave: make someone else the owner first.
ws.inviteSub: Send a link by email, or make a link to share yourself. Links work for 7 days and once.
ws.claudeSub: Which Claude account this workspace's runs use.
ws.modeSharedHelp: Every run uses the workspace's account, set here by the owner.
ws.modeMemberHelp: Each run uses the account of the ticket's member. Members connect theirs in their profile.
ws.connectionSub: Used by every run in shared mode.
ws.kindSubscriptionHelp: Run `claude setup-token` where you are signed in to your Claude plan, and paste the token.
ws.kindApiKeyHelp: Create a key in the Anthropic Console (sk-ant-api…). Usage is billed by Anthropic to its owner.
ws.keyStep1: Sign in to the Claude Console (button below) and open Settings → API keys.
ws.keyStep2: Click Create Key, name it (for example agnts) and pick the Console workspace it bills to.
ws.keyStep3: Copy the key (it starts with sk-ant-api) and paste it below. The Console shows it only once.
ws.keyStep4: Runs are billed per token to that Console account: add credits and set a spend limit under Billing.
ws.subscriptionsOff: This server takes Anthropic API keys only.
ws.fallbackHelp: When the chosen account is at its limit or missing, runs continue on agnts's API key and spend the workspace's credits instead of pausing.
ws.fallbackOff: Credits are not available on this server.
ws.defaultMemberHelp: Tickets from Jira, Plane, follow-ups and incidents run on this member's account in per-member mode.
ws.memberAccountsSub: Who has connected their own Claude account (Profile → Claude).
ws.viewerBanner: You are a viewer here: you can see everything, but you cannot change anything.
ws.inviteAsHelp: Members work on tickets; viewers only look.
ws.claudeSubMuse: Which Muse account this workspace's runs use.
ws.fallbackHelpMuse: When the chosen account is missing or out of budget, runs continue on agnts's Muse key and spend your free credits, then the workspace's credits, instead of pausing.
ws.memberAccountsSubMuse: Who has connected their own Muse account (Profile → Muse).
ws.museSignInHelp: Shows a code to confirm on Meta's page; runs then use that Meta account's Muse.
ws.museCode: Enter this code on Meta's page
ws.muse_denied: The sign-in was declined on Meta's page.
ws.muse_expired: The code expired before it was confirmed.
ws.museKeyHelp: Paste a Muse API key (it starts with LLM_). Usage is billed by Meta to its owner.
ws.claudeSubBoth: Which Muse and Claude accounts this workspace's runs use.
ws.fallbackHelpBoth: When the chosen account is at its limit or missing, runs continue on agnts's key and spend credits instead of pausing.
ws.memberAccountsSubBoth: Who has connected their own Muse and Claude accounts (Profile).
ws.noAccountModules: Your modules have no account to connect here: Codex runs on the workspace's OpenAI integration.
ws.codexSub: Runs on the workspace's OpenAI API key
ws.codexNotConnected: Not connected: Codex runs wait until one is
ws.codexCredits: OpenAI bills Codex runs directly, per call. They don't use workspace credits, and turning on continuing with credits doesn't apply to them.
